title: Default quick commands for FPVBuddy, Hobo and Grover
goal: The default list offers Show batteries and Show warehouse and Show drones (FPVBuddy), Show trip (Hobo) and Grover status, each calling that project's MCP tool
acceptance: Each default names the owning project's tool as that project publishes it; Show warehouse and Show drones call FPVBuddy's fleet and spares tools and screens (fpvbuddy:F-011-T01 to F-011-T05)
A test lists the defaults against fake servers that offer those tools
privacy: Neutral invented commands, servers and results only; no tokens in configuration examples, tests or logs.
escalation: A command that needs a tool another project has not planned goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: four configuration entries checked against the other projects' published tool names. Not a measurement. 2026-11-26: "Show warehouse" and "Show drones" are backed by fpvbuddy:F-011 (T01-T05: drone and spares tools, surface-typed data, the drones and warehouse screens for NERV), so no entry ships disabled; depends on fpvbuddy:F-011-T03 and fpvbuddy:F-011-T05.
